# RampRidge

> Old School RuneScape's Varrock West Bank, rebuilt as a live peer-to-peer USDC
> exchange in the browser. Players walk into the bank, chat, and buy or sell
> USDC for fiat with real players. Every trade settles through the Peer
> protocol (ZKP2P) on Base; RampRidge never holds anyone's funds.

- Play: https://www.rampridge.xyz/
- Source (MIT): https://github.com/ADWilkinson/rampridge
- Peer protocol: https://peer.xyz

## How trades work

- Buying: pick an offer at a bank booth's Exchange or from a merchant, pay the
  seller directly (for example Revolut, Wise, Zelle or Cash App), prove the
  payment with the PeerAuth browser extension in Chrome or Brave on a
  computer, and Peer's escrow contract releases the USDC to your wallet.
- Selling: deposit USDC into Peer's escrow with a payout handle. Orders are
  priced at the live oracle rate with an optional spread of -5% to +5%.
- Fees: Peer's fee and a 0.5% RampRidge buy fee come out of the USDC
  received and are listed on every confirm screen. RampRidge waives its fee
  when the seller's order already carries its Peer referral code.
- A practice trade walks the whole buy flow on a simulated seller, wallet and
  extension, with no login and no money.
- Logins: email, Google, an existing Peer account or any wallet, through
  Privy. Email and Google logins get a smart wallet on Base with sponsored gas.

## Notes

- RampRidge is an unofficial fan project. RuneScape and Old School RuneScape
  are trademarks of Jagex Ltd; RampRidge is not affiliated with or endorsed by
  Jagex. The repository contains none of the game's art, models, sounds or
  fonts.
- Chat filters links, wallet addresses and payment handles; trades only
  settle through the bank's interfaces.
- Buying and selling are real transactions on Base mainnet.
